name: Vertuoza
positioning: End-to-end construction company management — quote, planning, site, hours and invoicing in one chain.
description: Vertuoza is a management platform for construction companies in France and Belgium: estimating, planning, site follow-up, worker time tracking, purchase and stock, invoicing and profitability analysis, with a field app for teams on site.
real_estate_use: The recurring loss in a small construction firm is untracked labour hours. Vertuoza chains the estimate to the planning and the hours actually clocked on site, so the profitability of a job is known while it is running rather than at the year-end accounts — which is the only point at which it can still be corrected.
features: Estimating with work and price libraries
Worker time tracking from the field app
Profitability tracking per site against the estimate

use_cases.job: Know a job's real profitability while it is running, not at year end
Schedule teams and track hours from the same system as the estimate
